mapper.update: update `mall-rider`.rider_base set total_price = total_price + #{param.amount} , deposit = deposit - #{param.amount} where rider_id =#{param.payUid}
update ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_resource set user_money= user_money + #{money} where user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_money, user_recharge_card FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_resource WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ui.user_id, ui.user_name, ui.user_mobile, ui.user_lastlogin_time, pr.user_id, pr.user_money_pending_settlement, pr.user_money, pr.user_money_frozen, pr.user_recharge_card FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_resource pr on ui.user_id = pr.user_id where ui.shop_id is null
and ui.user_name like concat('%',#{param.userName},'%')
and ui.user_mobile like concat('%',#{param.userMobile},'%')
order by ui.user_id desc

SELECT ob.shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON ob.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id WHERE sb.shop_type = 3 AND (ob.payment_number = #{outTradeNo} or ob.order_id = #{outTradeNo}) GROUP BY ob.shop_id
